tools.name: activate_window
tools.description: Bring a top-level window to the foreground by title (or handle), and verify it took. Raises the window itself; the returned ref points at the window so it can be searched with 'within'. 'focus_in_window' says whether the screen reader's focus followed: a window can be in front while the keyboard focus, and so the reader, is still in the previous one.

inputSchema.description: Bring a top-level window to the foreground.

outputSchema.description: The window that ended up in front, and how it got there.

tools.name: click_at
tools.description: Click absolute screen coordinates. Last resort when nothing is actionable; reports the object that was under the point.

inputSchema.description: Click absolute screen coordinates.

outputSchema.description: Result of a raw pointer click.

tools.name: dismiss
tools.description: Leave a dialog: Escape first, then an explicit Cancel, No, Close, Abort, or Stop button. Never activates a dialog's default button. Allowed in modal and menu states so an agent can get out of a dialog it entered.

inputSchema.description: Dismiss the current dialog.

outputSchema.description: What dismiss tried, and whether a dialog remained.

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Execute Python source inside NVDA and return console output/result.

inputSchema.description: Execute Python code in NVDA.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Move keyboard focus to an object by ref, then wait for the UI to settle.

inputSchema.description: Move focus to a referenced object.

tools.name: get_action_trace
tools.description: Read back the retained diagnostic timeline for one action by its trace_id: lifecycle milestones, structured exceptions, the event window it spanned, the baseline and final UI projection, the expected-postcondition result, and best-effort native log matches. Every action response carries a trace_id. An expired trace returns found=false with the retention window.

inputSchema.description: Identify one action trace to read back.

outputSchema.description: One retained action trace, or the reason it is not available.

tools.name: get_focus_lineage
tools.description: Get focused object with ancestor chain for hierarchy debugging.

inputSchema.description: Get focus lineage with ancestors.

tools.name: get_log_context
tools.description: Return the chronological native log records surrounding one entry_id found by search_logs. Expands evidence with bounded before/after counts or time windows, preserves thread and line information, and reports whether the window is complete.

inputSchema.description: Return surrounding evidence for one previously found log entry.

include_focus.description: Include the focused control and its top-level window.

include_addons.description: Include add-on counts and the running add-on names.

include_logs.description: Include the tail of NVDA's native log.

log_lines.description: Log lines when include_logs is true.

tools.name: invoke
tools.description: Invoke an object's default or named action (press it) by ref, then wait for the UI to settle. Works on an unfocused control; returns changed/delta.

inputSchema.description: Invoke an object's default action, or a named one.

outputSchema.description: Result of invoking an object action.

tools.name: list_loaded_addons
tools.description: List running/available NVDA addons with metadata.

inputSchema.description: List loaded addons.

tools.name: list_reading_targets
tools.description: List a document's positions of one kind in reading order — headings, links, landmarks, form fields, tables, and so on — without moving the cursor. This is the screen reader's Elements List as data: one call gives the structure of a page or document, with refs where a control backs the position. 'available' says what this document can be searched by (browsers, Word and PDFs only); 'stopped' and 'truncated' say why the list ends where it does.

inputSchema.description: Enumerate a document's positions of one kind, without moving the cursor.

items.description: One position in a document, in reading order.

outputSchema.description: A document's positions of one kind, in the order a reader meets them.

tools.name: locate
tools.description: Find controls by role and/or name anywhere in the current window (or under a ref), and return a ref for each match. Searches with the application's own UIA provider when it can, otherwise with a bounded walk; 'method' says which answered. Use it to reach a control that is not the focus or next to it.

detail.description: summary leaves path, depth, automation id and states empty.

inputSchema.description: Search for controls by role and name.

anyOf.description: Screen rectangle in pixels; the same shape everywhere.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Move through the accessibility tree (next/previous/first/last/parent/child) from a ref or the focus, focus the result and return its ref.

inputSchema.description: Move through the accessibility tree.

outputSchema.description: Result of moving through the tree.

tools.name: navigate_reading
tools.description: Move a document's reading position like the screen reader's quick nav key: 'next' heading, 'previous' link, 'first', 'last'. 'steps' skips ahead (three headings is one call). Works in browse-mode documents only — browsers, Word, PDFs — and moves the real cursor, so the screen reader announces it. 'reached' and 'stopped' report a move that ended early instead of pretending it finished.

inputSchema.description: Move the document's reading position.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Capture the screen once: focus, ancestors, children, dialog and window, each with a ref. References are locators for invoke/focus/read, valid until the observation is superseded; state_version identifies this observation.

include.description: Optional sections beyond focus and the top-level window.

detail.description: summary leaves states empty; full includes them.

inputSchema.description: What to capture in one observation.

tools.name: press
tools.description: Send keyboard keys (e.g. 'tab', 'control+a'), then wait for the UI to settle. 'dispatched' means the input was posted; changed/delta say what the UI did.

keys.description: Gesture name, e.g. control+a or down.

inputSchema.description: Send keyboard keys.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text from an object by ref (or the focus) at a scope: line, selection, document or subtree. Bounded by max_chars, reports truncation.

inputSchema.description: Read text from a referenced object, or the focus.

tools.name: reload_plugins
tools.description: Reload all global plugins and app modules from scratchpad.

inputSchema.description: Marker type for tools with no input.

outputSchema.description: Result of reloading global plugins and app modules.

tools.name: restart_nvda
tools.description: Restart NVDA with optional parameters (disable addons, debug logging).

inputSchema.description: Restart NVDA with options.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the focused container up/down/left/right by page or line, then settle.

inputSchema.description: Scroll the focused container.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search native NVDA logs by severity, logger/source, add-on, message, thread, time and explicit trace_id. Returns paginated structured records with stable entry_id references, original times and line ranges, and explicit completeness metadata. Use to locate warnings, errors, or subsystem activity; it does not determine root cause.

sources.description: Glob filters over the native logger/source string.

message.description: Substring or bounded-regex filtering of a record's message.

inputSchema.description: Search native NVDA log records with structured filters.

tools.name: set_value
tools.description: Set a control's value by ref; an empty string clears it. Uses the platform value pattern when the control exposes one, otherwise focus + select-all + type; 'mode' says which. Reads the control back afterwards: 'verified' says the write landed, 'observed' carries what the control actually contains when it did not.

inputSchema.description: Set the value of a control.

outputSchema.description: How a value was set, and whether the control agrees.

tools.name: show_message
tools.description: Show a UI message to the user.

inputSchema.description: Show a UI message to the user.

tools.name: speak_text
tools.description: Speak the given text using NVDA's speech system.

inputSchema.description: Speak text using NVDA's speech system.

tools.name: start_browse_mode
tools.description: Start browse mode for a document NVDA is reading in focus mode, the way NVDA+space does, and report the implementation that now answers. The reading tools need this: Word and some PDF readers keep documents in focus mode until asked, so list_reading_targets and navigate_reading refuse until a model exists. Changes the user's session; 'created' is false when one was already there, so asking twice is harmless.

inputSchema.description: Start browse mode for a document NVDA is reading in focus mode.

outputSchema.description: The document that is now readable, and whether this call created it.

tools.name: summarize_logs
tools.description: Compute bounded, deterministic statistics and repeated diagnostic patterns from native NVDA logs: severity/source distribution, normalized repeated messages, exception and warning groups, time buckets, noise share and anomaly candidates. Use when the relevant error, logger or subsystem is not yet known.

sources.description: Glob filters over the native logger/source string.

inputSchema.description: Compute bounded deterministic statistics over native log records.

coverage.description: What a summary examined and what it could not claim.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic summary of native log evidence.

tools.name: wait_for_events
tools.description: Block until the next coalesced UI transition (or timeout) and return the transition kinds. Use for idle waits instead of polling observe.

inputSchema.description: Wait for the next coalesced transition.

tools.name: walk_object_tree
tools.description: Walk a bounded object subtree for focus/navigator/desktop.

inputSchema.description: Walk object tree with bounds.
